description: This file defines an enumeration 'PdfAnnotationFlags' representing various flags that modify the behavior and appearance of PDF annotations within the PdfSharp library. It uses bit flags to indicate different properties such as visibility, printability, zoom and rotation independence, visibility, interactivity, lock status, and toggle behavior.

classes.name: PdfAnnotationFlags
classes.description: An enumeration marked with Flags attribute, defining various annotation behavior flags used in PDF annotations, each represented as a distinct bit value.
